newsitem.title: USA: Procter names Grey to Ivory account.
newsitem.headline: Procter names Grey to Ivory account.

text.p: The Procter & Gamble Co said Thursday it is assigning advertising responsibility for its Ivory personal cleansing brand in North America to Grey Advertising Inc effective immediately.
Grey replaces Saatchi & Saatchi Advertising in this role.
The company said that Saatchi & Saatchi remains one of its largest and most valuable agencies, with continued responsibility for such brands as Tide, Cascade, and Comet.

In addition to Ivory, the company said Grey handles advertising for a number of other Procter & Gamble beauty care and cosmetic brands, such as Cover Girl, Giorgio, Hugo Boss, Laura Biagiotti, Pantene, and Sure.
The Ivory products Grey will be in charge of are Ivory Soap, Ivory Moisture Care, also a bar soap, and Ivory Moisture Care, a liquid body wash.
